_note: Guided tour (ADR 0110): "Take the tour" in the row of tool buttons; it never opens by itself. One step per entry, in order. Texts = i18n tour.<id>.title and tour.<id>.text. target = CSS selector(s); every match is outlined and the first visible one is scrolled into view (jump, no smooth scroll: ADR 0033). A step whose target is missing or hidden is skipped.
